verdict.rationale: Kit's pricing page lists 'A/B test subject lines & content' and 'A/B test subject lines' as features, so variant testing exists. Nothing in the evidence describes how the test runs or that a winner is automatically picked and sent based on engagement. Per-broadcast open and click stats exist but are not tied to A/B testing. missing for 10: documentation of automatic winner selection based on opens/clicks, test configuration details (split size, test duration, winning metric), any docs beyond pricing-page bullet points, independent or hands-on corroboration.
